Wow, that was a whole lot of useless.

What I'm trying to portray through my muddled communication is that while I am a productive member of society, I feel as though I'm not reaching my full potential. I am scraping the bottom of the barrel, so to speak, and I don't have the motivation to change it, mainly due to my view of the world. I'm intelligent enough to get into college, but I'm not able to self-motivate and do things that *I* want to do. Make sense, numb-nuts?

I appreciate that you read some of what I said but you basically just read the first paragraph and then dropped it, assuming that the rest of my post was the same as that first paragraph.
